MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro: WHOA! You shocked me! …Oh, you're just a kid!
MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle: Kids like you shouldn't be wandering around here in the dark.
MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro: Did you come to explore the cave, too?
MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle: I came all the way down here to show off to girls.
MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro: Wow! It's way bigger in here than I thought!
MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle: How do you get out of here? It's so big, I may get lost.
MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanIntro: What! Don't sneak up on me!
MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle: I have to find stronger POKéMON. Where might they be?
MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro: What? I'm waiting for my friends to find me here.
MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle: I came because I heard there are some very rare fossils here.
MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro: Suspicious men are in the cave. What about you?
MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle: I saw them! I'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!
MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro: You need to go through this cave to get to CERULEAN CITY.
MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle: ZUBAT is tough! But if you can catch one, you'll be able to count on it.
MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils:
Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here under MT. MOON.
Sometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM lends me a hand.
